description: Generates a context recovery prompt from a past Claude Code session.

evals.name: Context-recovery prompt for a different session
evals.prompt: Give me a context recovery prompt for my session on the auth feature, so I can start a fresh session with that context.
evals.expected_output: Produces a structured context-recovery document (per the Context Recovery Template), mentions claude --resume as an alternative.

evals.name: Correctly redirects an in-place continuation request
evals.prompt: My session just crashed with ctrl-c, help me continue working on it right here in this conversation.
evals.expected_output: Declines and points to session-recover instead, per its own stated 'When NOT to Use' exclusion -- does not synthesize a recovery document for this request.

evals.name: Resume with implicit current session (current fallback)
evals.expected_output: Step 1: resolves session via current project discovery (session_store.py list --project ... --format json, or fallback to current if empty). Step 1 command includes --format json per quality gate. Step 2: Extracts resume data via session_transcript.py. Step 3: Produces portable Markdown recovery document (provenance marker + 6 sections: What worked on, Key files, Decisions, Pending work, Last state, Git commits), not direct action. Offers claude --resume alternative.
